'''Lexington, KY CoT signing 15 January 2003 - report by Darrell Durham'''

''report posted at Dragonmount.com''



His speech went the same as Mr. Jordan corrected the pronunciations of certian names. After that he pointed out to the room to answer questions for the fans. My favorite answer was when someone asked if he'd write Conan again. Mr. Jordan replied, "If God, himself told me to write Conan, again I'd say, Satan allready told me too and I turned him down. So maybe we can make a deal." After finishing up the fans questions he told us that he was going to step down from the stage and enjoy lots of gin and sign our books.

It was really wonderful to meet one of my favorite authors and have a book signed.

I hope the rest of the fans get out to this event.
